resources.string: DriftNotes needs location access to show you on the map and know when you arrive.
Allow background location so reminders can fire when the app is closed.
In app settings, open Location and choose "Allow all the time" so reminders can fire when the app is closed.
Allow notifications so DriftNotes can alert you when you arrive.
Reminders need location "all the time" and notifications.
Turn on Location Services to use location reminders.
